title: سنن الترمذي
author: محمد بن عيسى الترمذي
editor: أحمد محمد شاكر (ج ١-٢)، محمد فؤاد عبد الباقي (ج ٣)، إبراهيم عطوة عوض (ج ٤-٥)
notes: Pages are the book's text from turath.io's export of Shamela 1435 (files.turath.io/books-v3/1435.json, fetched 2026-11-19), with the HTML tags taken out, and each export page cut at the print's page mark («⦗٦٤٨⦘») so a stored page holds only its printed page. The .notes.md beside a page holds what the export prints under the page's rule: al-Albani's grading of the hadith that ends on that export page (5/647: 3747 «صحيح»; 5/648: 3748), which the Shamela copy appends to each hadith. Only the pages a unit cites are stored.
